greeting: Departure day, Dan. The trip you've staged for weeks finally casts off at 5:55, so this is the day to clear the dry-land to-dos before signal gets thin.

needsAttention.title: Halloween: St. Pete or Maine
needsAttention.detail: Overdue since Sept 5, and the Oct 18 rotation booking fires while you're at sea with no signal. It's one decision with three bookings hanging off it. Call it before wheels-up.

needsAttention.title: Grab EU adapters and a power strip
needsAttention.detail: Type F / Schuko for Croatia, plus one US power strip so a single outlet charges the whole boat. This is the last errand that only works from a US store today.

needsAttention.title: The Cavtat room for Sept 19
needsAttention.detail: Your last night after the charter, near the airport, refundable, with the noon Komolac-to-Cavtat transfer. Poor signal aboard means booking it before you board Saturday.

needsAttention.title: Confirm the Nautilus boarding details
needsAttention.detail: You board the 12th. Confirm the meeting time and place with the instructor and lock the Sept 19 return transfer now, while you still have a reliable connection.

schedule.title: Flight to Frankfurt
schedule.detail: TPA to FRA, gate F88, UA 9661 / 4Y 65

flagged.title: Appliance-repair invoice due
flagged.detail: Clarke Customer Care billed you for the July 31 service call. Worth a look before you're offline for a week.

flagged.title: LinkedIn message from Yvonne
flagged.detail: A note is sitting in your LinkedIn inbox awaiting a reply.

inbox.noise: The rest is airline confirmations, boarding passes, baggage receipts, and Airbnb host logistics, all handled.

resolved.title: Checked bags are on the Croatia ticket
resolved.detail: The Discover Airlines baggage receipt for Tampa to Dubrovnik came through today, closing the p1 worry about carry-on-only limits.

resolved.title: Replied to Carol Hansell
resolved.detail: You answered her note this morning and offered to talk today or after the 19th, so the ball's in her court now.

recipe.title: Butternut squash & candied bacon on fresh pasta
recipe.why: Autumn's first hard squash meets smoke and sweetness over fresh noodles.

tasks.title: Book St. Pete lodging for the Sept 20-22 landing gap
Book refundable backup car, Sept 20 - Oct 5

acts.line: A last quiet morning in St. Pete for packing and the final US errands, with the larder bin to drop at your mom's on the way to Tampa.
Check out by ten, rental back at TPA around noon, then a few open hours at the gate before boarding.
Wheels up at 5:55 for Frankfurt, then the 9:15 hop lands you into Dubrovnik tomorrow morning.
